correctness.rationale: The unique pole of order 7 gives g=6 and 3-rank 0. The canonical differential has divisor 10P, so the six displayed forms comprise a regular differential basis. Cartier on these forms has rank 3 when a is nonzero and rank 2 when a is zero; its second iterate has rank exactly 1, and the third is zero. The identities are proved algebraically and exact exhaustive F3/F9 matrix checks corroborate the universal proof.
